papers.title: NCP-ArchPreview: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
papers.what: Product-quantizes a model's own hidden states into a concept vocabulary, trains a Concept Module to predict the next multi-token concept, and feeds that prediction back to condition token generation, scaled to 8.9B parameters over 5.73T tokens as the largest latent-space language model reported so far.
papers.builds_on: Coconut (Hao 2024, 2BJAGQ5K); Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); Latent Reasoning Survey (Zhu 2025, EMXEJYHV)

papers.title: CARDEA: Auditable Reasoning Grounded in Spatial Evidence for End-to-End Coronary Angiography Interpretation
papers.what: Trains a vision-language model on closed-ended angiography labels with a verifiable reward that also pays for citing bounding boxes inside the reasoning trace, and finds the reinforcement stage alone surfaces zero-shot report generation the model was never trained on, lifting vessel-severity macro-F1 from 0.513 to 0.686.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); UNI Pathology (Chen 2023, 6T29JLTN); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF)

papers.title: X-AuT: Progressive Audio-Encoder Compression for Speech LLMs with Cross-Scale Distillation
papers.authors: Zhang, Zou, Chen et al. (XPENG AI)
papers.what: Selects which audio-encoder layers to drop by short behavioral probes rather than weight statistics, then repairs the pruned encoder by representation alignment and distillation from a larger teacher with the language backbone frozen, cutting 18 layers to 16 while macro-average error falls from 5.61 to 5.27 percent.
papers.builds_on: HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU); Audio Mamba (Erol 2024, 6VTXUZEG); Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM)

papers.title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence
papers.authors: Diao, Wang, Ding et al. (65 authors)
papers.what: Removes both the vision encoder and the variational autoencoder so an 8B mixture-of-transformers model reads and writes image patches in one stream trained by spatially coherent patch reconstruction, then folds capability-specific experts back together by multi-expert on-policy distillation.
papers.builds_on: BLIP-2 (Li 2023, 4N5WXKPI); Stable Diffusion (Rombach 2022, DULT32HM); DiT (Peebles 2023, YJ9TK993)
